correspondences.notes: BIDS has no ICA decomposition suffix.

brainlife.desc: ICA decomposition of MEG/EEG in MNE format (ica.fif): unmixing matrix, components and the list of excluded components.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/ica
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Removing artifact components (EOG, ECG) from the same raw or epoched data.

**Not for:** Other recordings than the one it was fitted on. Head-MRI transforms (one App reads a transform from this datatype).

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 6 Apps, output of 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.ica.json

files.desc: MNE ICA FIF with the fitted decomposition and excluded components.

identifying_risks: MNE measurement info in the ICA FIF can carry subject_info, meas_date and digitised head points.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level M/EEG derivative linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Run mne anonymize (info) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the measurement info keeps subject_info (name, birth date) or meas_date.
